IMP-0360.evidence_requirement: 1) a schema-conformance pass over every template and custom role; 2) a rights-escalation attempt through a custom role, expected refused.
IMP-0360.output_schema: command-center/schema/receipt.schema.json profile=council-runtime-module (required: unit_id, artifact_paths[], spec_anchor, evidence[], test_ids[], negative_control_ids[], reviewer_verdict, residual_unknowns[])
IMP-0360.question_or_target: Implement tools/council/roles/templates.py providing reusable role templates plus a path to author a custom role that still satisfies the mandate contract (spec 11177). Falsifiable question: can a custom role be authored that grants itself rights no template allows, and is template drift from the mandate schema detected?
IMP-0360.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot (AGENTS.md 4b): after two failures sharing an error fingerprint, enumerate >=2 alternative designs before a third attempt
IMP-0360.reviewer_requirement: one independent adversarial reviewer in a fresh context who did not author the module and starts from the tests, not the author's summary
tests_required: unit: template resolution and custom-role validation
negative control: author a rights-escalating role and assert refusal
IMP-0360.title: Role-template registry with custom-role authoring

IMP-0372.evidence_requirement: 1) a null-change control run measuring the noise band on the same harness; 2) the candidate's delta reported against that measured band, not against zero.
IMP-0372.output_schema: command-center/schema/receipt.schema.json profile=selfimprove-measure-artifact (required: unit_id, artifact_paths[], spec_anchor, evidence[], test_ids[], negative_control_ids[], reviewer_verdict, residual_unknowns[])
IMP-0372.question_or_target: Implement tools/selfimprove/measure.py building each candidate in an isolated worktree and running the benchmark and regression suite before and after. Falsifiable question: is the measured delta outside the noise band of repeated identical runs, and is the noise band measured rather than assumed?
IMP-0372.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot (AGENTS.md 4b): after two failures sharing an error fingerprint, enumerate >=2 alternative designs before a third attempt
IMP-0372.reviewer_requirement: one independent adversarial reviewer in a fresh context who did not author the module and starts from the tests, not the author's summary
tests_required: control: null-change run establishes the noise band
measurement: candidate delta vs measured band
negative control: a no-op candidate must NOT be reported as an improvement
IMP-0372.title: Isolated implementation with a measured benefit gate

IMP-0374.evidence_requirement: 1) the new test executed against the pre-fix commit, required RED; 2) the same test against the post-fix tree, required GREEN.
IMP-0374.output_schema: command-center/schema/receipt.schema.json profile=selfimprove-writeback-module (required: unit_id, artifact_paths[], spec_anchor, evidence[], test_ids[], negative_control_ids[], reviewer_verdict, residual_unknowns[])
IMP-0374.question_or_target: Implement tools/selfimprove/writeback.py recording each retained lesson into the correct skill, rule or workflow AND adding a regression case so the same failure cannot silently return. Falsifiable question: does the new regression case actually fail against the pre-fix tree - if it passes there too, it protects nothing?
IMP-0374.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot (AGENTS.md 4b): after two failures sharing an error fingerprint, enumerate >=2 alternative designs before a third attempt
IMP-0374.reviewer_requirement: one independent adversarial reviewer in a fresh context who did not author the module and starts from the tests, not the author's summary
tests_required: both-states control: new regression case must be RED pre-fix and GREEN post-fix
control: writeback target verified in the REPO, not only in the live deployed tree
negative control: a test that passes in both states must be REJECTED as non-protective
IMP-0374.title: Lesson writeback and benchmark augmentation

IMP-0390.evidence_requirement: Recall@5 on the planted-mutant paraphrase set for lexical vs semantic, same control set, same seed; plus the exact pinned model id and digest.
IMP-0390.question_or_target: Implement the second-stage semantic matcher over capability descriptions using a version-PINNED local embedding model, with a documented offline fallback when the model is unavailable. Exact question: does the semantic stage recover the paraphrase pairs that the lexical linter provably cannot, measured on the planted-mutant set from IMP-0388?
IMP-0390.retry_policy: max 3 attempts for model-fetch transients; zero retries on a nondeterministic ranking - that is a design defect
IMP-0390.reviewer_requirement: independent-codex-reviewer, fresh context, must re-run the recall measurement
IMP-0390.tests_required: determinism test: same query + same pinned model + same seed yields byte-identical ranking twice. Offline test: with the model absent, the matcher must degrade LOUDLY (typed DEGRADED result), never silently return lexical results labelled as semantic.
IMP-0390.title: Semantic matcher with pinned local embedding model and offline fallback

IMP-0402.evidence_requirement: Timed edit-then-query trace showing the changed answer, plus the observed behavior on a deliberately truncated and a deliberately zero-byte cache file.
IMP-0402.question_or_target: Implement cache invalidation for the capability index using content hash plus mtime, with an explicit corrupted-cache recovery path. Exact target: editing a capability description must change the router's answer on the very next call, and a truncated cache file must trigger a rebuild rather than a crash or a silently empty index.
IMP-0402.retry_policy: max 2 attempts; two-strikes pivot to unconditional rebuild
IMP-0402.reviewer_requirement: independent-claude-reviewer; must specifically check that an empty index is not reported as OK
IMP-0402.tests_required: corrupted-cache test (truncated, zero-byte, wrong-schema); each must rebuild, and an EMPTY rebuilt index must be treated as a failure not a success.
IMP-0402.title: Index staleness invalidation keyed on content hash

IMP-0409.evidence_requirement: Concurrency run output: 50 attempts, exactly 1 grant, 49 typed DENIED results with reason codes. Raw counts, not a summary sentence.
IMP-0409.question_or_target: Implement claim acquire, renew and release for a work unit using atomic tmp-plus-rename with a TTL, so two sessions can never both hold the same unit. Exact question: under 50 concurrent acquire attempts on one unit id, how many claims are granted?
IMP-0409.retry_policy: max 2 attempts; a second double-grant is a design failure - redesign, do not retry
IMP-0409.reviewer_requirement: independent-codex-reviewer, fresh context, re-runs the concurrency test
IMP-0409.tests_required: concurrency test at N=50; crash test where the holder is killed mid-claim and the TTL must eventually release it; a mutation removing the atomic rename must turn the concurrency test red.
IMP-0409.title: Crash-safe work-claim protocol with TTL

IMP-0415.evidence_requirement: A twelve-row condition table mapping each spec condition to the exact function and line that evaluates it; any condition with no implementing line is a gap, disclosed inline.
IMP-0415.question_or_target: Implement the ONE shared completion reducer covering all twelve conditions at spec lines 10631-10644 as a single importable library with no per-caller variants. Exact target: exit code zero alone must be structurally incapable of returning COMPLETE.
IMP-0415.retry_policy: no automatic retry; the reducer is the program's single point of epistemic failure
IMP-0415.reviewer_requirement: 2 independent reviewers: correctness plus an adversarial refuter attempting to construct a false COMPLETE
IMP-0415.tests_required: exit-zero-alone test must return INCOMPLETE. Each of the twelve conditions gets one violating fixture that must be rejected.
IMP-0415.title: Shared completion predicate implemented once as a library

IMP-0421.evidence_requirement: Recorded invocation showing the prompt file path on the command line (not the prompt body), the exit code, AND the non-empty parsed output-last-message file. Exit code alone is SEVERED, not SUCCESS.
IMP-0421.failure_classification: P0-blocking / classes: severed-stream, fire-and-forget, win-arg-limit, codex-exit-n, schema-invalid
IMP-0421.question_or_target: Implement the Codex adapter: blocking foreground invocation, prompt delivered by FILE not inline, --ignore-user-config, and an explicit output-last-message file. Exact target: a work-unit dispatch must be structurally unable to run detached, because a detached result is unreachable by the fan-in barrier.
IMP-0421.retry_policy: max 1 retry ONLY on a win-arg-limit classification, re-invoked with --ignore-user-config; all other failures escalate immediately
IMP-0421.reviewer_requirement: independent-codex-reviewer, fresh context; must confirm the three-signal AND-gate
IMP-0421.tests_required: AND-gate test: exit 0 with a missing or empty output file must classify as severed-stream, not success. Detached-invocation test: any attempt to background must raise at the API boundary.
IMP-0421.title: OpenAI-side work-unit adapter with prompt-by-file transport

IMP-0423.evidence_requirement: A forced-mismatch dispatch showing the DEGRADED verdict, the preserved partial artifact path, and its byte size.
IMP-0423.question_or_target: Implement the degrade-loudly contract at spec line 10983: on a capability mismatch the dispatcher returns a typed DEGRADED result and PRESERVES the partial artifact, never a silent substitution and never a discard. Exact target: there must be no code path where a mismatch produces an ordinary-looking success.
IMP-0423.retry_policy: no automatic retry; retrying a capability mismatch cannot fix it
IMP-0423.reviewer_requirement: adversarial refuter; must attempt to produce a silent success from a mismatch
IMP-0423.tests_required: mismatch test asserting DEGRADED not SUCCESS; artifact-preservation test asserting the partial file still exists after the failure; a mutation that discards the partial must turn the test red.
IMP-0423.title: Degrade-loudly contract for capability mismatch

IMP-0441.evidence_requirement: Exit codes of both gates on the Windows working tree before and after, plus confirmation that the Linux CI run stayed green across the change (a fix that greens Windows by reddening CI is a regression).
IMP-0441.question_or_target: Add the EOL attributes that make the command-center gates runnable on the primary development box, then prove both gates exit zero on a Windows working tree. Exact target: the machine the program is authored on must be able to run its own gates - today both exit nonzero purely from CRLF while being genuinely green in CI.
IMP-0441.retry_policy: max 2 attempts; escalate rather than normalizing line endings destructively across the tree
IMP-0441.reviewer_requirement: independent-claude-reviewer runs both gates from a clean re-clone on Windows
IMP-0441.tests_required: dual-platform gate test; a control asserting the pre-fix Windows run really was red, so the after-state is not silence in both states.
IMP-0441.title: EOL policy and a Windows-checkout green-gate proof

IMP-0442.evidence_requirement: A time-series of observed concurrent units per substrate across a 40-unit mixed dry run; the local-serialized series must be flat at one.
IMP-0442.question_or_target: Implement the dispatcher that reads the catalog and routes each unit to its declared execution_substrate, with local-serialized meaning strictly one at a time. Exact question: with a catalog containing units of all four substrates, does the observed simultaneous count for local-serialized ever exceed one?
IMP-0442.reviewer_requirement: independent-claude-reviewer inspects the time-series, not the summary
IMP-0442.tests_required: substrate-isolation test per substrate; a mutation removing the serial lock must show a concurrent count above one and turn the test red.
IMP-0442.title: Work-unit dispatcher honoring the declared execution substrate

IMP-0451.evidence_requirement: Four-cell truth table (monitor alive/dead x work active/idle) with the detector verdict in each cell; any cell where the detector guesses instead of returning UNDECIDABLE is a defect.
IMP-0451.question_or_target: Implement both detectors from spec lines 11315-11316 together: a monitor that dies while remote work continues, and a live monitor that merely has nothing to report being mistaken for dead. Exact target: the two states must be distinguishable, and where they are not, the detector must return UNDECIDABLE rather than guessing.
IMP-0451.reviewer_requirement: adversarial refuter constructs the hardest cell
IMP-0451.tests_required: all four cells as tests; a mutation collapsing the two signals into one must make two cells indistinguishable and turn the test red.
IMP-0451.title: Stale-monitor and no-change-monitor detectors as a matched pair
